logger.doc:name: Security Error Logger
logger.message: #["Security error - Method: " ++ (attributes.method default "UNKNOWN") ++ ", Path: " ++ (attributes.requestPath default "UNKNOWN") ++ ", Trace ID: " ++ (vars.traceId default correlationId)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: { code: "UNAUTHORIZED", message: "Authentication required", details: "Access token is missing or invalid", timestamp: now(), traceId: vars.traceId default correlationId, path: attributes.requestPath default "", method: attributes.method default "", statusCode: 401, retryable: false, helpUrl: "https://docs.api.company.com/authentication" } }

logger.doc:name: Validation Error Logger
logger.message: #["Validation error - " ++ error.description ++ ", Trace ID: " ++ (vars.traceId default correlationId)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: { code: "VALIDATION_ERROR", message: "Request validation failed", details: error.description, timestamp: now(), traceId: vars.traceId default correlationId, path: attributes.requestPath default "", method: attributes.method default "", statusCode: 400, validationErrors: [{ field: "request", message: error.description, code: "VALIDATION_FAILED" }], retryable: false, helpUrl: "https://docs.api.company.com/errors/validation" } }

logger.doc:name: Bad Request Logger
logger.message: #["Bad request error - " ++ error.description ++ ", Trace ID: " ++ (vars.traceId default correlationId)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: { code: "BAD_REQUEST", message: "The request is malformed", details: error.description, timestamp: now(), traceId: vars.traceId default correlationId, path: attributes.requestPath default "", method: attributes.method default "", statusCode: 400, retryable: false, helpUrl: "https://docs.api.company.com/errors/bad-request" } }

logger.doc:name: Not Found Logger
logger.message: #["Resource not found - Path: " ++ (attributes.requestPath default "UNKNOWN") ++ ", Trace ID: " ++ (vars.traceId default correlationId)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: { code: "RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND", message: "Resource not found", details: "The requested resource does not exist", timestamp: now(), traceId: vars.traceId default correlationId, path: attributes.requestPath default "", method: attributes.method default "", statusCode: 404, retryable: false, helpUrl: "https://docs.api.company.com/errors/not-found" } }

logger.doc:name: Method Not Allowed Logger
logger.message: #["Method not allowed - Method: " ++ (attributes.method default "UNKNOWN") ++ ", Path: " ++ (attributes.requestPath default "UNKNOWN") ++ ", Trace ID: " ++ (vars.traceId default correlationId)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: { code: "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", message: "HTTP method not allowed", details: "The HTTP method " ++ (attributes.method default "UNKNOWN") ++ " is not allowed for this endpoint", timestamp: now(), traceId: vars.traceId default correlationId, path: attributes.requestPath default "", method: attributes.method default "", statusCode: 405, retryable: false, helpUrl: "https://docs.api.company.com/errors/method-not-allowed" } }

logger.doc:name: HTTP Timeout Logger
logger.message: #["HTTP timeout error - " ++ error.description ++ ", Trace ID: " ++ (vars.traceId default correlationId)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: { code: "GATEWAY_TIMEOUT", message: "Gateway timeout", details: "Timeout while waiting for upstream service response", timestamp: now(), traceId: vars.traceId default correlationId, path: attributes.requestPath default "", method: attributes.method default "", statusCode: 504, context: { upstreamService: "process-api", timeoutDuration: "30s" }, retryable: true, retryAfter: 30, helpUrl: "https://docs.api.company.com/errors/timeout" } }

logger.doc:name: HTTP Connectivity Logger
logger.message: #["HTTP connectivity error - " ++ error.description ++ ", Trace ID: " ++ (vars.traceId default correlationId)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: { code: "BAD_GATEWAY", message: "Bad gateway", details: "Unable to connect to upstream service", timestamp: now(), traceId: vars.traceId default correlationId, path: attributes.requestPath default "", method: attributes.method default "", statusCode: 502, context: { upstreamService: "process-api", upstreamError: error.description }, retryable: true, retryAfter: 10, helpUrl: "https://docs.api.company.com/errors/connectivity" } }

logger.doc:name: Business Error Logger
logger.message: #["Business logic error - " ++ error.description ++ ", Trace ID: " ++ (vars.traceId default correlationId)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: { code: "BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION", message: "Business validation failed", details: error.description, timestamp: now(), traceId: vars.traceId default correlationId, path: attributes.requestPath default "", method: attributes.method default "", statusCode: 422, context: error.additionalInfo default {}, retryable: false, helpUrl: "https://docs.api.company.com/errors/business-rules" } }

logger.doc:name: System Error Logger
logger.message: #["System error - " ++ error.description ++ ", Detail: " ++ (error.detailedDescription default "N/A") ++ ", Trace ID: " ++ (vars.traceId default correlationId)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: { code: "INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR", message: "An internal server error occurred", details: "An unexpected error occurred while processing the request", timestamp: now(), traceId: vars.traceId default correlationId, path: attributes.requestPath default "", method: attributes.method default "", statusCode: 500, retryable: true, retryAfter: 30, helpUrl: "https://docs.api.company.com/errors/server-errors" } }

sub-flow.name: extract-error-context-subflow
sub-flow.set-variable: #[{ "timestamp": now(), "service": "order-experience-api", "operation": flow.name, "correlationId": correlationId, "traceId": vars.traceId default correlationId, "userId": attributes.headers."x-user-id" default null, "clientId": attributes.headers."client_id" default null }]
